integrity: Signed integral chain calculations and full finite group-character enumeration supplied in standalone, rerunnable standard-library programs. Same-model review only; independent verification not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the rational equivariant bidegree-(3,4) representation for the incidence graph of PG(2,3) is new. The rank q^2 per endpoint is prior art. The asserted module isomorphism is abstract and rational, not an integral or canonical cycle-level isomorphism; finite calculation only at q=3.
title: Ordered projective triangles realize the rational magnitude-homology representation of PG(2,3)
